answer: By the oasis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Work waits on the atlas until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the reef of the next round. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing.
